author: RLHGaming
quote: Biggest disappointment in gaming history.  Shows how far we've gone wrong since the early 20 teens.  Gaming industry needs a reset and I can't believe they missed the mark on this one.  Feels and plays like a low action just cause

author: RLHGaming
quote: I already played skyrim and oblivion, I didn't need to play them again.  Reskinned those games with outer space.  Had to quit when I landed on the planet with my own home and had to run a ways to get to my house.  NOPE

author: RLHGaming
quote: I actually feel the game itself is an 8.  Very enjoyable, no bugs that I noticed and a freedom of choice you don't find elsewhere.  I'm giving it a 10 because the way Larian went about this game is the least-scumbag thing I've seen in the gaming industry in at least a decade.  Thank you for this game and your moral compass.

author: RLHGaming
quote: You sir get a 0.  It takes about 80 levels to hit the point where the game is just awful and all of the cracks are exposed.  An ARPG with seasons needs to let you know right away if it's not for you (POE does this in the first little bit when it displays the skill tree).  D4 drags you along with potential for a lot of fun at some point, but the end of the journey is a wasteland devoid of any fun or dopamine.  I used to cry for Deckard Cain's demise, now I see he's the lucky one.

author: RLHGaming
quote: This game brought me back to my childhood.  But not the childhood I had, the one I wished I had had.. where the PS1 / PS2 cinematics were the actual gameplay.  The boss fights are incredible, the story is captivating and the combat can be intense.  Timing is everything and it can be punishing sometimes.  Tons of skills, tons of builds.  My vote for GOTY.

author: RLHGaming
quote: Played on gamepass.  So happy I didn't pay $70 for this game.  I read nothing about it going in.  30 fps at 1080p on series x?  No thank you.  game wasn't fun and looks like trash.

author: RLHGaming
quote: To see the gaming titan of my childhood tarnish the esteemed name of Diablo is truly saddening.  Diablo-like was used for decades to describe the action rpg genre (similar to Doom-like until fps was coined).  To have it minimized to the lowest common denominator and contain all of the toxic and abusive cash grab tactics of our time is a slap in the face.
